help.density_tolerance: Convergence threshold of the density residual

help.dos.bands: bands solved on the DOS mesh; 0 = automatic (raise it to extend the DOS above E_F)
help.dos.kpoint: SCF k-point used before the NSCF mesh
help.dos_emax: upper edge, absolute eV (default where the highest solved band starts + 3 sigma; above it the DOS is incomplete)
help.dos_emin: lower edge of the energy grid, absolute eV (default lowest band - 1 eV)
help.dos_grid: full uniform NSCF mesh for the DOS (no symmetry reduction); typically denser than --scf-grid
help.dos_sigma: Gaussian broadening in eV; converge it together with --dos-grid
help.dos_step: energy grid step in eV; must not exceed sigma/3
help.eigen_search_factor: S3 inexact inner solve: eigen tolerance = factor * outer residual, in (0, 0.1]

help.force_tolerance: maximum allowed atom force norm, eV/A
help.hubbard: Dudarev model, e.g. Fe:2:4; may repeat for different elements
help.incremental_ritz: update the projected matrix incrementally (native default)
help.initial_moments: one initial magnetic moment per atom, muB
help.kpoint: Fractional k-point used when no SCF mesh is given
help.onecenter_density_tolerance: maximum per-atom normalized Frobenius residual of the one-centre occupation matrix
help.path: JSON file containing a list of fractional k-points
help.paw_compensation: S5 scope of compensated PAW accumulation
help.paw_root: PAW archive folder with manifest.json, index.json and potentials.jsonl.xz
help.projector_interpolation: PAW reciprocal projector interpolation; default cubic, or inherit frozen SCF for NSCF; use spline to match VASP NLSPLINE
help.projector_radius_factor: S6 real-space projector sphere as a multiple of the PAW radius, in [1, 2]
help.projector_space: S6 real-space projectors during inexact search only (FP64 reciprocal certificate unchanged); slower than reciprocal on every swept cell up to 64 atoms
help.relax.cutoff: cutoff in eV; omitted selects it from PAW ENMAX
help.relax.density_tolerance: Convergence threshold of the density residual in each relaxation SCF
help.relax.sparsity: off: exact discretization (16xENCUT density, padding 2) with the certified solver defaults; custom: only the components given below; auto: probe-driven choice, explicit components override; relax resolves auto once on the starting geometry and keeps it for every step
help.scf_acceptance_margin: scale of the SCF acceptance thresholds, in (0, 1] (default 1)
help.scf_checkpoint: reuse a verified converged PAW scf.json; skip SCF recomputation
help.scf_grid: full uniform SCF mesh; all points contribute to density
help.search_operator_floor: below this eigen tolerance S6/S7 search operators are bypassed, in (0, 1e-2] (default 1e-6)
help.search_precision: S7 working precision of inexact search (fp32 has no kernel in this build)
help.smearing_ev: Fermi-Dirac kBT in eV; zero uses global zero-temperature occupations
help.sparsity: off: exact discretization (16xENCUT density, padding 2) with the certified solver defaults; custom: only the components given below; auto: probe-driven choice, explicit components override
help.sparsity_candidates: S1 factors to try, in [4, 24); the probe measures each
help.sparsity_level: S1 tail budget: balanced = fitted rule (2.5e-7), conservative = 1/4 of it, aggressive = largest measured pass (4.25e-7)
help.sparsity_max_factor: largest S1 factor auto may choose (also caps the fallback), in [4, 24]
help.sparsity_metric: probe tail metric; a non-default metric needs --sparsity-tail-budget
help.sparsity_min_factor: smallest S1 factor auto may choose, in [4, 24]
help.sparsity_tail_budget: absolute S1 tail budget in (0, 1e-3]; replaces --sparsity-level
help.spin_channels: 1 nonmagnetic; 2 collinear; inherit frozen model for bands
help.stress_tolerance: maximum stress component, eV/A^3; default 0.05 GPa
help.threads_per_rank: OpenMP threads per rank; default OMP_NUM_THREADS (or cores) / ranks
help.xc_padding: S2 XC quadrature padding per axis (code default 2)

sparsity.intro: Sparsification lowers the cost of the SCF. Search components (class E) only change how the fixed point is reached; the final FP64 eigen certificate and the density thresholds still decide convergence. Discretization components (class A) change the discrete functional and are bounded by the spectral probe and the sweep-calibrated rules.
sparsity.level_note: The level only moves the S1 tail budget; S2–S7 follow the rules below. The preview runs the density spectrum probe (no SCF) and shows what auto would choose. The density-mode ratio is the (factor/16)^1.5 scaling at a fixed cell, not a measured speed-up.
